column1: # poseidon_params.tsv: the Poseidon parameters behind PoseidonConstantsCircuit::<F>::default() (Neptune-derived, Strength::Standard, HashType::Sponge, domain tag 0).
# They are generated deterministically; nothing is random:
# - round numbers (rf full, rp partial) from calc_round_numbers (the Poseidon paper's script with a security margin: rf += 2, rp = ceil(1.075*rp)), the values are listed below;
# - MDS matrix: Cauchy, M[i][j] = 1 / (i + t + j) over the field (t = width), symmetric (asserted equal to the matrix nova serialises);

# - round constants: the Grain LFSR of the Poseidon reference (generate_parameters_grain.sage) with init (field=1 prime field, sbox=1 x^5, field_size=255, t, rf, rp) -> constants taken 255-bit (top bits masked, rejection sampled below p), (rf+rp)*t of them. The generator is the file src/grain.rs (copy of nova's round_constants.rs).
# The library additionally stores compressed/sparse versions (optimised, equivalent); a plain implementation with the raw constants reproduces every output in poseidon.tsv (asserted).
# Records: <field> <mode> params ... | grain_init ... | mds_row <i> <t elements concat, 32 B LE each> | rc_round <round> <t constants concat>
# <field> constants_bincode_len <bytes> <sha256>: size/hash of bincode1(PoseidonConstantsCircuit) as stored inside the vk (ro_consts_primary/secondary fields).
